tagline: Export operations, without the spreadsheet chase.
loginLead: Sign in with the email and password on your staff account.
setupHint: Used once, when no staff account exists yet.
adminCreated: Administrator created. Sign in with the email and password you just entered.
name: Name
scopedCounts: Scoped to cases this account may see.
noFakePercent: No completion percentage is shown because the API does not provide a numerator and denominator.
noCargoKpi: This board has no cargo-delivery total. Port arrival is not customer delivery.
casesHint: Track export files across documents, bank review, containers and courier stages.
selectCase: Select a case to preview fields already on this list.
opsHint: Counts come from live operations. Overdue uses reminder due times, not invented percentages.
heroSubtitle: Track every export file from booking through delivery.
sidebarHint: Every document, stage and reminder stays with the case file.
liveHint: Updates arrive automatically. No manual refresh needed.
containersHint: Move a container along its journey here: the row updates instantly, no refresh.
containerSummaryHint: Summary of the containers listed below.
searchContainer: Search by container or booking number
remindersHint: Snoozing applies immediately; the list stays live without a refresh.
notificationsUnread: Unread notifications are highlighted; opening one marks it as read.
timelineEmpty: No movements have been recorded yet.
timeline.container.ARRIVED_PORT: The container arrived at the port
timeline.courier.DISPATCHED: The documents are on the way to you
timeline.courier.IN_TRANSIT: The documents are still in transit
timeline.courier.DELIVERY_EXCEPTION: The documents could not be delivered
timeline.documents.SHARED: A file was sent for your review
searchBooking: Search by booking or case reference
bookingsHint: Create the sea booking before the export case. Link it when loading starts.
reportsHint: Operational totals computed from recorded events only — no estimates.
bankReviewHint: Only completed handover → decision pairs are counted.
customersHint: Every customer keeps its contacts, addresses and export history in one place.
searchCustomer: Search by legal or trade name
newCustomerHint: Save the legal name and primary contact first; addresses and bank details can be added without blocking the case.
customerProfileError: Could not save the customer profile. Reload if someone else changed it.
keepAccountHint: Leave the number blank to keep the current ending.
noCasesForCustomer: No export cases for this customer yet.
usersHint: Provision accounts and shape roles; every change is written to the audit log.
settingsHint: Company identity, custom fields, reminder rules, document templates and WhatsApp messages. Each section stays in its own tab.
activityHint: The audit trail: every recorded action, newest first.
whatsappMessagesHint: Write the message the customer receives. Bold, italic, strike and fixed width use WhatsApp marks. Colors, fonts and pictures are not included. Bank details and files stay out.
whatsappPreviewSample: Sample data for the preview, not a real shipment.
whatsappStoragePending: This is the original message. Saving a custom message waits until the database upgrade is applied.
whatsappTooLong: Keep the message within 800 characters so the WhatsApp link can open.
whatsappLinkHeavy: This sample is long enough that some phones may not open the WhatsApp link. Shorten the message.
companyIdentityHint: Only the system administrator can change the name, theme, sign-in logo and browser icon.
faviconHint: Shown on the browser tab. PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF or ICO, up to 256 KB.
companyLogoHint: Shown at the center of the sign-in page. PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to 512 KB.
search: Search by case, invoice, booking, container, or customer
profileHint: Update the name, email and password for this account.
profileEmailHint: Confirm the change with your current password. The new address is used the next time you sign in.
profilePasswordHint: Enter the current password, then choose a new one of at least 12 characters.
passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
courierNotCargo: Courier status is not customer delivery.
dashboardLoadError: Could not load dashboard counts from the API.
tradeSynced: Summary copied from the packing list
tradeIncludesFreight: Add sea freight to the invoice total
tradeStampHint: Click where the stamp should land
tradeStampMissing: Upload a transparent PNG stamp before placing it.
netAboveGross: Net weight cannot exceed gross weight.
tradeIssue: Issue and attach to the operation
tradeIssued: Commercial invoice and packing list issued
proformasHint: A proforma can stand alone, then be linked to an export operation and converted.
proformaFromCase: Create a proforma for this operation
noCases: No export cases match this filter.
newCaseHint: Save a draft as soon as the customer is known. The invoice total is goods plus the freight written on the invoice.
invoiceTotalHint: Calculated from goods plus the freight on the invoice. Actual freight is not added.
caseDenied: Case not found or not permitted.
completeWithoutCustomer: The customer has not approved the documents yet. Are you sure you want to close the operation?
slotsNote: container slots. Port arrival is not customer delivery.
noInvoices: No invoices on this case yet.
directRouteCopy: This case uses the direct route. Bank stages are not required and must not block dispatch.
shareHint: The share link stays here until you revoke it. Revoking stops the link immediately and removes it. Bank details stay hidden. A file appears after you send it for the customer's review.
shareTokenUnavailable: This link is active, but its address was not kept and cannot be shown again.
customerSaveError: Could not save customer. Bank fields require bank-details permission.
noCustomers: No customers yet. Create one to start an export case.
bankHidden: Hidden or none. Bank identifiers are permission-gated.
scheduleHint: Planned dates are distinct from actuals. Empty dates mean not yet confirmed.
importHint: Preview never writes. Commit is refused when any row is invalid.
importNothingSaved: Nothing is saved. This screen only previews the file.
import.err.LEGAL_NAME_REQUIRED: A legal name is required on this row.
fieldOptionsHint: Separate choices with commas. Required for a choice field.
draftFieldsHint: Required extra fields can wait while this record is still a draft.
trackingUnavailableBody: This link is expired, revoked, or invalid.
portNotDelivery: Port arrival is not the same as customer delivery.
manualSourceNote: Courier and milestone dates are entered manually. This is not a live carrier feed.
errors.gross: Gross weight cannot be less than net weight.

errors.INVALID_PDF: The file could not be read. Choose a valid PDF and try again.
errors.DOCUMENT_STILL_UNAPPROVED: The operation cannot be completed until required documents are reviewed and approved.
errors.DOCUMENTS_TRACK_INCOMPLETE: The operation cannot be completed until required documents are reviewed and approved.
errors.GOODS_TRACK_INCOMPLETE: Port arrival is not customer delivery. Record actual container delivery first.
errors.BANK_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: This step is not available until the previous stage is finished.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This step is not available until the previous stage is finished.

errors.USER_NOT_AUTHORIZED: You do not have permission to do this. Ask an administrator if you need access.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this. Ask an administrator if you need access.
errors.BOOKING_CONTAINER_COUNT_INVALID: Check the requested container count before saving the booking.
errors.GROSS_LT_NET: Gross weight cannot be less than net weight.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again later.
errors.SERVER_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: The request could not be completed. Check the latest saved data before trying again.
errors.CUSTOMER_TRACKING_UNAVAILABLE: This tracking link is unavailable or has expired. Ask the company for a new link.
errors.GONE: This tracking link is unavailable or has expired. Ask the company for a new link.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the server. Your last change may not have been saved.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last active administrator cannot be removed or disabled.
errors.INVOICE_LOCKED: This invoice is locked because the export operation is completed. An exceptional correction is required.
errors.INVOICE_CORRECTION_REASON: Write the correction reason before saving.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_LOCKED: Exceptional correction is only for a completed export operation.
errors.REMINDER_REPEAT: Repeat interval must be 1 to 90 days, or empty for once.
errors.REMINDER_STALE: Another save changed this reminder rule. Reload it and review the current values before trying again.
errors.REMINDER_SAVE_UNCONFIRMED: The save may have finished, but the confirmation was lost. Check the latest values before trying again.
errors.REMINDER_RECOMPUTE_TOO_LARGE: This reminder rule touches too many rows to update in one safe step. No change was saved.
invoiceLocked: This invoice is locked because the export operation is completed. A permitted user can open it, edit it, then lock it again.
invoiceOpenHint: Each export operation has one invoice. Add it after the case is created, then edit it while the operation is still a draft or active.
completedInvoicePermissionHint: Choose which roles may edit an invoice after the export operation is completed, or open it for editing and lock it again. The administrator already has this permission.
correctionIntro: The total is calculated from the goods value and the freight written on the invoice. Actual freight is not added.
commercialTotalHint: The commercial total is goods plus the freight written on the invoice. Actual freight is an internal cost and is not added. On FOB, leave invoiced freight at zero.
bookingFirstHint: Each export operation takes one sea booking. Create it first, then link it here.
oneBookingHint: This export operation already has its sea booking.
createCaseAndLink: Create the export case and link this booking
lockedFieldsHint: These extra fields are locked with the invoice. An exceptional correction is required to change them.
errors.CONFLICT: This record was updated by someone else. Refresh and try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Check the entered values and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large for this upload.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTION_INVALID: Choose one of the available options.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTIONS_INVALID: Add at least one choice for this field.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_REQUIRED: Fill in the required extra fields.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_KEY_INVALID: Use a lowercase key with letters, numbers, and underscores.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_LABEL_INVALID: Enter both Arabic and English labels.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_DUPLICATE: This field key is already used for that record type.

errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_LABEL: Enter both Arabic and English labels.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTIONS: Add at least one choice for this field.
bothApproved: Approved by the customer and the company
customerFileNotReleased: The company has not approved a file for you yet.
customerReviewClosed: The file stays available to view and download. Review and approval are closed.
reopenCustomerReview: Allow the customer to review again
customerReviewReopened: The customer can review and approve again
customerFilesHint: Open the file, then accept it or write what should change. Accepting it does not replace the company's own check.
customerFileAccepted: You accepted this file. The company still confirms it.
customerFileChangesSent: Your note was sent. A new file will appear here when it is ready.
customerFileStaffStill: Your own approval is still required.
rule.review: Uploaded document is waiting for review
reminder.docMissing: Required document is not yet uploaded
reminder.uploadScan: Upload a scanned PDF of the original
reminder.reviewWaiting: Uploaded document is waiting for review
reminder.reviewAction: Review and approve or request correction
reminder.bankReview: Bank still has originals under review
reminder.courierCheck: Courier shipment needs a manual status check
reminder.bookingAction: Review booking dates and container progress
reminder.checklist: Complete commercial details and document checklist
errors.INVOICE_VERSION: The invoice changed since you opened it. Refresh and review the correction again.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_TAKEN: This invoice number is already used. Enter a different number.
errors.CASE_HAS_INVOICE: This export operation already has its invoice.
errors.CASE_HAS_BOOKING: This export operation already has its sea booking.
errors.CUSTOMER_CODE_TAKEN: This customer code is already used.
errors.CUSTOMER_CODE_INVALID: Use a short customer code of letters, numbers, and dashes.
errors.CONTAINER_SLOT_IN_USE: Only an empty planned container can be removed.

whatsAppPhoneMissing: This customer file has no phone number, so WhatsApp opens without a direct chat.

noRevisions: No invoice changes have been recorded yet.

confirmBankHandover: Acknowledge and hand over to the bank
bankCheckDocInvoice: The commercial invoice is not approved or available.
bankCheckDocBl: The bill of lading is not approved or available.
bankCheckNoInvoice: There is no invoice to compare with the booking.
bankCheckNoBooking: There is no booking to compare with the invoice.
noFileYet: No file uploaded for this requirement yet.
perm.invoices.correct_completed: Edit a completed invoice, or open it and lock it again
quotationsHint: Independent commercial quotations and proforma documents.
quotationItemsEmpty: No items yet — add at least one before issuing.
quotationReviseHint: Items are copied exactly from the current revision.
quotationSearch: Search by number, title or customer
